create_model_subclass: create a subclass of Model that implements _forward to process TensorDict inputs for a multi-agent group
build_sequence_model_config: build a SequenceModelConfig with MlpConfig and GnnConfig layers and intermediate sizes for a multi-agent experiment
check_output_agent_dim: check if a model output will have the agent dimension given share_params and centralised flags
parse_model_config_dict: parse a model config dictionary resolving class name strings into actual class objects via _class_from_name
load_model_config_from_yaml: load a ModelConfig from a YAML file using the get_from_yaml class method on a ModelConfig subclass
